name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the switch shown in the Home App

numberConfiguredScenes.title: Max. Scenes
numberConfiguredScenes.description:
Maximum number of configurable programmable switches.
The number of really used switches can be changed during runtime.

triggerTimeout.title: Reset Timeout
triggerTimeout.description: Seconds, after which the switch and trigger index is reset (0 = disabled).

resetAfterSwitchOff.title: Reset when switch is turned `Off`
resetAfterSwitchOff.description: Reset the switch and trigger index, when the stateless switch is turned Off

triggerSceneAfterSwitchOff.title: Trigger scene, when switch is turned `Off`
triggerSceneAfterSwitchOff.description:
Trigger scene 0 (so called Off-scene), when the stateless switch is turned Off (independent from timeout).
Note: If this is enabled, rotation starts from switch 1, otherwise 0.

debounceTimerMs.title: Debounce Timer (in milliseconds)
debounceTimerMs.description:
Time to wait before the next switch trigger is accepted.
Only change this value, if you encounter problems using the HomeKit slider in the Home App
